left.statement: Before identity is verified, do not say 'collections', 'debt', 'payment' or the product, to anyone including relatives and colleagues.
left.brief_quote: Do not say "collections", "debt", "payment" or the product before identity is verified.

left.statement: Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name confirms identity; 'Hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this' do not. Ask once more; if still unclear close not_reached/unclear. Answer a customer question first, and the ask that follows is the second ask.
left.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

left.statement: If another person answers: do not say why you call, say nothing beyond the opening sentence, and ask when the customer can be reached.
left.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence.

left.statement: A callback must be today or the next business day, 10:00-19:00 inclusive, and later than now. If the offered time is outside, ask once more; if still outside, do not schedule and close not_reached/no_callback.
left.brief_quote: ask once for another time. If that is also outside it, do not schedule.

left.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer security questions or be told about the account, even if they offer to pay.
left.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

left.statement: Send date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD whatever way it was said; read numeric-only dates as day, month, year. Send four digits for the phone.
left.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

left.statement: On hint day_month_swapped, ask the customer to say the month as a word; that retry does not count as a wrong answer.
left.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

left.statement: After three wrong answers in total, do not state the debt; tell the customer to use the Kestrel app or a branch and close not_verified/failed.
left.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

left.statement: If the customer declines to answer, explain once that the questions protect the account; a further refusal closes not_verified/declined. Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining; a second refusal or second such question closes the call.
left.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

left.statement: Call get_account only after every security question passes. State each late product in its own sentence (product in words, past_due, days_late) before asking for anything.
left.brief_quote: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything.

left.statement: Business days are Monday to Friday except the listed bank holidays. A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
left.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

left.statement: If the customer names a weekend day or holiday not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
left.brief_quote: offer the next business day

left.statement: If the customer asks for a date after the deadline, say the latest recordable date is the deadline and offer it; refusing the deadline is a flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it

left.statement: For a vague period, ask once for the exact day; if none is given, propose the deadline.
left.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

left.statement: Ask for the full past-due amount first; never ask 'how much can you pay?'. The agent proposes every amount.
left.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?".

left.statement: If the full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: Say that the rest stays overdue.

left.statement: A customer amount from floor to full inclusive is accepted; below the floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; not accepting it is a flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

left.statement: A date or amount proposed by the customer is never a refusal. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
left.brief_quote: A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal.

left.statement: When attempts are used up, stop and do not repeat a refused offer; close no_promise/refused.
left.brief_quote: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

left.statement: On illness, death in the family or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion attempt, offer the support team; accept -> transfer queue support, close transferred/support; decline -> no_promise/hardship. A date or amount the customer names is still recorded.
left.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt

left.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
left.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

left.statement: Read product, amount and date back and ask for confirmation; call create_promise only after a clear yes. If date or amount changes at this step, revalidate and read back again.
left.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

left.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.
left.brief_quote: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

left.statement: Say a promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true. If it fails, retry once; if it fails again say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
left.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

left.statement: 'I already paid': say payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, close paid.
left.brief_quote: payments can take one business day to appear

left.statement: Dispute ('not mine', 'never had this product', closed or paid off in the past): do not argue, take no promise, close no_promise/dispute.
left.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

left.statement: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan; transfer to queue restructuring and close transferred/restructuring.
left.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

left.statement: A request for a human: ask once whether you can help first; if they insist transfer to queue general and close transferred/human. Applies before and after verification.
left.brief_quote: ask once whether you can help first

left.statement: If asked whether this is a scam, say they can verify the call by phoning Kestrel Bank's customer service number, and continue. If asked whether you are a robot/AI, say you are Kestrel Bank's digital assistant and continue.
left.brief_quote: tell them they can verify the call by phoning Kestrel Bank's customer service number, and continue

left.statement: For a question not answerable from the tools, say you do not have that information; never invent figures, dates or reasons.
left.brief_quote: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

left.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk, close no_promise/refused; before identity is verified close not_verified/declined.
left.brief_quote: If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk

left.statement: Several products: ask first whether the customer can pay all today; if not, go through the products one by one in get_account order without asking about today again, starting each at attempt 1; attempts counted per product; band and deadline per product.
left.brief_quote: First ask whether the customer can pay all of them today.

left.statement: If one date is named for everything and it is after a product's deadline, record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back.
left.brief_quote: record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back

left.statement: Read all promises back together, ask for one confirmation, then call create_promise once per product using each product's account_ref.
left.brief_quote: Read all promises back together, ask for one confirmation

left.statement: For each product ending without a promise, call add_note with account_ref and the reason (declined, financial_difficulty, contested, already_paid, system_error), also when only one product or none gets a promise.
left.brief_quote: For each product that ends without a promise, call `add_note`

left.statement: A dispute or already-paid claim on one product does not end the call: note it and continue with the others.
left.brief_quote: A dispute or an already-paid claim on one product does not end the call.

left.statement: On a restructuring transfer, promises already recorded stay; agreed but unrecorded ones are dropped; before the transfer add_note reason declined for every product without a recorded promise. On support or human transfer add no notes.
left.brief_quote: On a support or human transfer, add no notes.

left.statement: If one create_promise fails twice, keep recorded promises and note the failed product with system_error.
left.brief_quote: note the failed product with reason `system_error`

left.statement: Exactly one close_call per call, as the last tool call, after thanking the customer and saying goodbye.
left.brief_quote: Every call ends with exactly one `close_call`

left.statement: Multi-product close: promise wins if at least one promise was recorded, except on a transfer (a transfer after a recorded promise closes as the transfer). With no promise: if every product is noted already_paid close paid; otherwise no_promise with the most serious note reason: dispute > hardship > refused > service_error.
left.brief_quote: `promise` wins whenever at least one promise was recorded, except on a transfer.

left.statement: The brief does not state a product id pattern; use the account_ref values returned by get_account unchanged.
left.brief_quote: Use that id in every tool call about the product.
